title: A Witness for the Letter
author: Coral Quintana
blurb: Marguerite Lockridge, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
